description: Lists every call a wallet made with brainchain_call, newest first, each settled by the newest published dataset: hit, miss, pending or already public, with the outcome row that settled it and the decision record. Counts how many settled each way. Every call the wallet paid for is in it, because the watcher reads them from BrainChain's DecisionLog, not from what the caller sends. Free, no key.

caller.description: The wallet that paid for the calls: the payer of each call's grade.

name: brainchain_calls
title: Read a wallet's calls and how they settled
